description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Producer_PartsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Producer_ReceiveParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Producer_AssembleInterior</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Producer_TestSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Producer_ConductTestFlight</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Producer_CreateTestProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Producer_SendTestProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Producer_ReceiveConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Producer_End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Producer_PartsSplit" name="Manufacture customized parts"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Team_ManufactureOtherParts" name="Manufacture other customized parts, including seats, color, and toilet water setup"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Producer_PartsJoin" name="Customized parts complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Producer_ReceiveParts" name="Receive individual parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Producer_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Producer_TestSplit" name="Test airplane and prepare protocol"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Producer_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Producer_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to producer and customer"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Producer_TestJoin" name="Test flight and protocol complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Producer_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Producer_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive customer delivery confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Producer_ReceiveConfirmation_Definition" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Producer_Flow_6" sourceRef="Team_ManufactureOtherParts" targetRef="Producer_PartsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Producer_Flow_7" sourceRef="Producer_PartsJoin" targetRef="Producer_ReceiveParts"/>
